name: Create a full-bleed exhibition cover with oversized heading and CTA
query: Create a full-width exhibition hero pattern inspired by a museum poster: a background image with dim overlay, a very large multi-line title, short descriptive copy, and one outlined Visit button.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route the task to wp-patterns and confirm the target theme, text domain, asset source, and pattern slug
Step 2: Create a filesystem pattern with Title, Slug, Categories, Keywords, and Viewport Width headers
Step 3: Use a Cover block aligned full with a background image, dim or duotone treatment, and generous viewport-height spacing
Step 4: Use a short oversized heading with tight line-height and clear hierarchy
Step 5: Place supporting copy and an action-specific outlined CTA below or beside the heading
Step 6: Escape and internationalize all visible strings and attribute text
Step 7: Verify the pattern inserts without block recovery and remains readable at desktop and mobile widths
success_criteria: Uses a full-width Cover block with image, dim/duotone treatment, and intentional content positioning
Creates poster-like scale through a short large heading rather than generic centered hero text
Includes descriptive supporting copy and one action-specific CTA
Uses escaped i18n functions for visible text and attribute text
Uses approved/local assets or asks before inventing asset URLs
Avoids scripts, inline style tags, custom CSS classes, and query-time PHP
Verification mentions editor insertion, block parsing, and responsive readability
